Crocs, I remember when nobody liked Crocs...now I think they are the new Birkenstocks...in a weird way. Anyways, Huckberry dropped some limited edition Crocs and apparently the internet went bananas. They are now marked up online of 5x...SO what are my thoughts on them? Do I dig these Croc boots? Are they tough? Will I slip if I wear them long enough? The world may never know. We of course have a competitor for these boots too -- Xtratuf Deck boots. My dad's (a commercial fisherman) all time favorite boots. How do these $75 Crocs stack up to $105 Xtratuf's? What about the $135 ones!? Who knows. 

Bye.
